description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sun Titan
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
